name: Struct-Bench
description: Struct-Bench is a benchmark and evaluation framework for differentially private synthetic data generation on structured datasets containing natural language components. It includes 5 real-world and 2 synthetic datasets and provides metrics and a leaderboard to standardize evaluation of privacy-preserving synthetic data methods.
reputation: A very recent benchmark proposal with emerging interest, but it is not yet a widely established community standard.
notes: Requires dataset structure representation as a Context-Free Grammar; includes reference implementations and a public leaderboard.
